answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 47128 Country: Pakistan Title: Doing supplication with hands raised during iftar time Question: I recently heard that we are not allowed to offer private dua with raised hands at the time of iftar (i.e. when Maghrib time is about to enter. Is this true? Answer ID: 47128 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1189/919/H=10/1434) There is no harm in supplicating silently and individually at the time of iftar. It is right without any karahat (undesirability), rather it is good. Not known from where you heard that? Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
